crossRefs.note: Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

people.name: Ham
people.line: One of Noah's three sons, father of Canaan.

people.name: Japheth
people.line: Son of Noah, ancestor of Indo-European peoples

people.name: Noah
people.line: Righteous man, built ark, survived flood

people.name: Shem
people.line: Noah's son, ancestor of Semitic peoples

translations.web: Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
translations.bsb: And Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
translations.kjv: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
translations.asv: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
